coin.title: 45 Years of Sesame Street 1 Ounce Silver
coin.description: The Royal Dutch Mint celebrates 45 years of Sesame Street! The Royal Dutch Mint mints a very limited Sesame Street silver bar. Last fall it was possible to vote on our website for which character you would like to see on a silver issue. Bert and Ernie proved to be the most popular and are now immortalized as a duo in relief and with colour on a silver piece in the highest quality Proof. The silver bar is made of pure silver weighing 1 troy ounce. Only 250 pieces will be produced, delivered with a numbered Certificate of Authenticity. The exclusive issue comes in a matching colourful and festive box.
